gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-diphylleia: Diphylleia is a serif whose stems outweigh its hairlines only slightly, so its texture feels lightly shaded. Diphylleia's openings stay clear at tiny sizes, so you can let the text run small beneath Comic Relief's ribbon-like, constant lines.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-donegal-one: Donegal One is a classic serif with refined authority. Its tempered contrast neither jolts nor flattens, and that sits against Comic Relief's constant-width, stem-thick bowls with a satisfying snap.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-fjord-one: Comic Relief draws every line at constant width, like blueprint lettering, with bowls left unfinished on one side. Fjord One's faintly modulated line is the steadier counterweight.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-gentium-book-plus: Gentium Book Plus reads as a traditional text serif, with wide openings and a thickness shift you feel more than see. Gentium Book Plus gives Comic Relief's bold, unshaded strokes a quieter partner to lean against.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-gfs-didot: Cable-bent heading, literary body. Comic Relief never swells or thins, while GFS Didot, a classic serif, keeps a modest stem-to-hairline ratio and generous curve gaps, and that gap between them is the pair's real strength.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-hahmlet: Comic Relief has no swelling where its curves meet the stems, and its bowls stay open on one side. Hahmlet, a classic serif, adds a faint charcoal-like pressure shadow.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-im-fell-english-s: Bookish and editorial, IM Fell English SC takes a gentle dip-pen variation in its strokes and keeps its throats open. Against Comic Relief's cord-heavy curves, that mild modulation is the draw.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-inria-serif: Comic Relief leads with curves that carry no stress at all, bold and commanding in its heading role. Inria Serif, a text serif, answers with stems just heavier than its hairlines.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-joan: Comic Relief fattens its crossbars to match the stems they join, giving the heading a blunt, bold presence. Joan, a classic serif, lets its stroke thickness vary softly beneath.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-junge: Dignified and authoritative, Junge is a classic serif with generous curve gaps and strokes that taper only slightly. Comic Relief is better at bold, single-thickness impact, while Junge excels at moderate thick-thin refinement.
